toegepas.blok: Van mens tot mens deur die lug
toegepas.voor: Wanneer iemand wat siek is hoes of nies
toegepas.na: Wanneer iemand wat siek is, hoes of nies
toegepas.rede_vinder: A comma where the finite verbs of two clauses meet ('is, hoes') stops the reader joining 'is hoes'.
toegepas.fout: The embedded relative clause runs straight into the main verb ('siek is hoes'), so the reader stumbles.
toegepas.rede_keurder: A comma closing the relative clause makes the sentence read cleanly on a first pass without changing anything it says.

toegepas.blok: Van mens tot mens deur die lug
toegepas.voor: Praat en sing maak dieselfde druppeltjies.
toegepas.na: Hy maak ook sulke druppeltjies wanneer hy praat of sing.
toegepas.rede_vinder: Verbs as subjects read woodenly, and 'dieselfde' literally means the identical droplets; 'sulke' is what is meant.
toegepas.fout: Bare verbs as subject ('Praat en sing maak') read woodenly, and 'dieselfde' literally means the identical droplets.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The proposal says the same thing in natural Afrikaans; 'hy' points to the sick person and the next sentence's 'hulle' still points to the droplets.

toegepas.blok: Van mens tot mens deur die lug
toegepas.voor: gebeur dit makliker en 'n oop venster
toegepas.na: gebeur dit makliker, en 'n oop venster
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb ('dit gebeur', 'n oop venster maak').
toegepas.rede_keurder: Punctuation fix only, as the AWS 2017 requires.

toegepas.voor: Ander mense sien 'n teken ook al vertel
toegepas.na: Ander mense sien 'n teken, ook al vertel
toegepas.rede_vinder: A comma separates the main clause from the concessive clause 'ook al vertel die mens niks'.
toegepas.fout: No comma before the concessive clause 'ook al vertel die mens niks'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: A comma setting off the concessive clause is standard and leaves every word intact.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Die meeste' with a countable noun takes the plural: 'hoeste'.
toegepas.fout: 'Die meeste' with the countable noun 'hoes' needs the plural.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Grammar fix to 'hoeste'; the quantifier 'die meeste' is untouched.

toegepas.voor: saam met die hoes op en soms
toegepas.na: saam met die hoes op, en soms
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb; the protected wording stays intact.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses ('slym kom op', 'daar is bloed').
toegepas.rede_keurder: Punctuation only; the protected wording 'Dikwels kom slym saam met die hoes op' stays word for word.

toegepas.blok: Die kliniek kan TB gesond maak
toegepas.na: Hy hou daarmee aan, ook nadat
toegepas.rede_vinder: Bare 'hou aan' lacks what he continues with, and a comma sets off the 'ook nadat' clause.
toegepas.fout: 'Hy hou aan ook nadat' runs together and the reader stumbles; it is also unclear what he keeps on with.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Daarmee' points back to drinking the medicine and the comma sets off the 'ook nadat' clause, with no change in meaning.

toegepas.blok: Waar masels vandaan kom en hoe dit lyk
toegepas.na: 'n Kind met masels kry hoë koors
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Die kind' has no antecedent; no child has been mentioned yet in this block.
toegepas.fout: 'Die kind' has no antecedent; no child has been mentioned in the block.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The proposal gives the reference without adding a fact, and 'hoë koors' stays intact.

laat_vaar.blok: Ander tekens en simptome van TB
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Probeer' here needs an object ('dit') to read naturally.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Sonder dat hy probeer' is already natural Afrikaans; adding 'dit' is a lateral move.

laat_vaar.blok: Die kliniek kan TB gesond maak
laat_vaar.voor: help hom om by te hou
laat_vaar.na: help hom om vol te hou
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Byhou' means keeping pace with something; 'volhou' is the idiom for persevering with a treatment.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Byhou' (keeping up with the doses) and 'volhou' (persevering) say different things about what the clinic does, and the original is acceptable Afrikaans.

laat_vaar.blok: Waar masels vandaan kom en hoe dit lyk
laat_vaar.voor: en trek af oor die lyf
laat_vaar.na: en versprei dan afwaarts oor die lyf
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Trek af' can be read as 'pull off'; 'versprei afwaarts' keeps the downward spread unambiguous.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Trek af oor die lyf' is clear in context, and 'versprei dan afwaarts' is longer and stiffer for a Grade 5 reader without being clearly better.

na_skrywer.voor: glo jy kry TB uit 'n beker, 'n bord of kos wat julle deel
na_skrywer.na: glo jy kry TB as jy 'n beker, 'n bord of kos met iemand deel
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: The pronoun shifts from 'jy' to 'julle' within one sentence, and 'TB uit kos kry' is awkward; the meaning stays the sharing myth.
na_skrywer.fout: The pronoun shifts from 'jy' to 'julle' inside one sentence.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: Changing 'uit 'n beker' (the cup as the source) to 'as jy ... met iemand deel' (the act of sharing) moves the myth being refuted, and sharing with a sick person nearby can involve airborne spread, so the writer must fix the pronoun another way.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

na_skrywer.voor: 'n Hoes wat twee weke of langer aanhou, moet kliniek toe gaan.
na_skrywer.na: Iemand met 'n hoes wat twee weke of langer aanhou, moet kliniek toe gaan.
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: A cough cannot go to the clinic; the person with the cough goes, and the clinic rule is unchanged.
na_skrywer.fout: The cough itself is made the subject that must go to the clinic.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: A real fault, but this is the lesson's instruction on when to go to the clinic, so the writer who owns that checked wording should fix who goes.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

na_skrywer.voor: 'n Droë hoes wat twee weke aanhou, gaan ook kliniek toe.
na_skrywer.na: Iemand met 'n droë hoes wat twee weke aanhou, gaan ook kliniek toe.
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: Same fault as the earlier sentence: the person, not the cough, goes to the clinic.
na_skrywer.fout: Same fault: the dry cough is the subject that goes to the clinic.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: Same as change 7: a real fault in a health-action instruction, which goes to the writer rather than being reworded here.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

na_skrywer.voor: veroorsaak word, meestal in 'n mens se longe,
na_skrywer.na: veroorsaak word en meestal 'n mens se longe aantas,
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: The phrase 'meestal in 'n mens se longe' hangs without a verb; 'aantas' attaches it to the disease.
na_skrywer.fout: The phrase 'meestal in 'n mens se longe' hangs loosely in the definition.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: This rewords a glossary definition, and 'aantas' also shifts it from where the disease sits to what it attacks, so it goes to the writer.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.teks: Ander mense sien 'n teken ook al vertel die mens niks.
vlae.rede: 'Sien' names only sight, while the sentence just before (and the shared definition) says a sign can be seen, heard, smelled or measured; narrowing back to sight looks like the visibility axis the definitions moved away from. Fixing it changes what the sentence says, so it is flagged, not changed.

beskerm_bedenkings.woord: TB kan gesond gemaak word / Die kliniek kan TB gesond maak
beskerm_bedenkings.rede: In standard Afrikaans a person is made healthy ('gesond gemaak') and a disease is cured ('genees'); 'TB gesond maak' is semantically odd. Left unchanged because it is protected; the 'kan' hedge would need to survive any rewording.
